## Welcome

This is a tutorial series for public health analysts, researchers, and data scientists who want to turn complex data into decisions that matter.

Each tutorial is hands-on, uses real or publicly available African health datasets, and includes full R code you can run immediately.

## Series

### Data Visualisation for Policy

How to build charts, maps, and dashboards that policymakers actually use.

*8 tutorials — starting March 2026*

## About the Author

Olamide Akeboi is a public health researcher and spatial analyst based in Nigeria, with expertise in spatial modelling, Bayesian geospatial methods, MERL and AI applications in global health.
